name: qa-watchdog
description: Autonomous post-commit code & visual QA watchdog. Automatically audits new commits in an isolated Git worktree using Playwright MCP, proposes architecture/performance/scalability improvements, and prepares isolated fix/qa-<sha> branches.
suggestedPrompts: Run a full QA Watchdog code and visual review on the latest commit
Check the latest QA Watchdog audit report and apply confirmed bug fixes
Audit the current app visually at desktop and mobile viewports with Playwright
